name: SCCW Debut Card

matches.note: John Murphy won by pinfall in 2 minutes, 11 seconds with a running powerbomb.
Superunknown won by pinfall in 11 minutes, 24 seconds after the arena's lights briefly went out.
Chris Craven won by submission with the Rings of Saturn.

note: The first half of the promotion's debut card, taped for local cable-access broadcast. Following the third match, a debuting wrestler interrupted to issue an open challenge; the second half of the card (a ten-man battle royal and a main event) is covered in a separate, uncollected document.
